subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Harmony
solution:
The correct answer is: **Discord**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Harmony"** refers to a state of agreement, peace, or concord between individuals or groups. It often denotes a pleasing arrangement or coexistence. (सामंजस्य)

 
 
• **Example:** The choir sang in perfect harmony, creating a soothing atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **"Discord"** refers to a lack of agreement or harmony between people, things, or situations. It signifies conflict, disagreement, or a clash of opinions. (कलह)
 
 
• **Example:** The discord between the two political parties led to a prolonged debate in parliament.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the most appropriate antonym of **'Harmony'** is **'Discord'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Discord**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accord** (सहमति): Agreement or harmony between people or groups.

 
 
• **Example:** The two nations signed a peace accord to end the conflict.
 
 
 
• **Unity** (एकता): The state of being united or joined as a whole.
 
 
• **Example:** The team’s unity was evident in their flawless performance.
 
 
 
• **Concord** (सामंजस्य): Agreement or harmony between people or groups.
 
 
• **Example:** The community lived in concord, helping each other in times of need.
